2608.03910.title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory
2608.03910.paper_summary: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse social contexts, alignment can no longer be framed as the optimization of a single, unified set of values. Instead, systems must be able to recognize, represent, and respond to multiple legitimate perspectives. This has led to growing interest in pluralistic alignment, which seeks to move beyond one-size-fits-all models of appropriate behaviour. However, current approaches often lack a clear account of how values are socially organized, contested, and coordinated in practice. In this paper, we argue that social theory provides essential conceptual and design resources for addressing these challenges. Drawing on established traditions in sociology, we show how perspectives can be understood as structured by roles, shaped through interaction, and distributed across fields of power and expertise. We translate these insights into concrete implications for AI system design, including role-based representations, structured coordination among perspectives, and context-sensitive evaluation. For agentic systems, this requires aligning not only final outputs, but also the role activations, deliberative traces, aggregation rules, and feedback loops through which those outputs are produced. Our contribution is to reposition pluralistic alignment as a problem of socially grounded coordination rather than output diversification. We outline a design space for systems that engage multiple perspectives in structured and accountable ways, and we identify directions for future work to implement and empirically evaluate these approaches in real-world settings.
2608.03910.paper_summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧系統在日益多樣化的社會背景中部署，對齊不再能夠被框定為對單一、統一價值觀的最佳化。相反，系統必須能夠識別、表達並回應多種合法的觀點。這導致了對多元對齊日益增長的興趣，該興趣旨在超越一刀切的適當行為模型。然而，當前的方法往往缺乏對價值觀在社會中如何組織、爭議和協調的清晰說明。在本文中，我們主張社會理論為應對這些挑戰提供了必要的概念和設計資源。基於社會學的既有傳統，我們展示了如何將觀點理解為由角色結構化、通過互動塑造並在權力和專業領域中分配。我們將這些見解轉化為對人工智慧系統設計的具體啟示，包括基於角色的表徵、觀點之間的結構化協調以及情境敏感的評估。對於自主系統來說，這不僅需要對最終輸出進行對齊，還需要對角色激活、深思的痕跡、聚合規則和產生這些輸出的反饋迴路進行對齊。我們的貢獻在於將多元對齊重新定位為一個社會基礎協調的問題，而非輸出多樣化。我們勾勒出一個設計空間，讓系統以結構化和負責任的方式參與多種觀點，並確定未來工作的方向，以在現實世界中實施和實證評估這些方法。
